technology_name: A CERVICAL CANCER SCREENING SYSTEM WITH A GUIDED VISUAL ASSISTANT USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Decentralized low-cost oncology checkpoints lack fast, automated tracking systems to detect early cervical abnormalities accurately without specialized laboratory pathologists.
description: A portable medical imaging framework integrating a high-resolution colposcopic capture lens array, an edge-computing deep learning processing engine running an automated Region of Interest (ROI) classifier block, and an integrated display monitor.
applications: Gyn-oncology field screening drives, community health clinic diagnostic tools, rural medical center accessibility units, and automated digital colposcopy systems.
